cases.title: Autonomous Code Security & PR Vulnerability Triage (28 Fields)
cases.text:
CI/CD PIPELINE AUDIT #PR-10822
Repository: payment-gateway-core
Branch: feature/direct-stripe-integration -> main
Author: external-contractor-92 (First PR submitted)
Diff Summary: +482 lines, -12 lines in src/services/charge_processor.py and config/aws.env

Static Scanner Findings:
1. Hardcoded Plaintext AWS Root Secret: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE..." committed into config/aws.env
2. Unsanitized SQL Query Concatenation: cursor.execute(f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = '{req.user_id}' AND secret = '{req.token}'")
3. Insecure Deserialization: pickle.loads(base64.b64decode(req.headers['X-Payload'])) detected in webhook handler.
4. Dependency Check: Added vulnerable PyPI package 'requests-oauthlib==0.4.0' with 3 critical CVEs.

Deployment Target: PRODUCTION (us-west-2 Kubernetes Cluster)
Compliance Scope: SOC2 Type II, PCI-DSS Level 1, HIPAA
Security Gate Status: FAILED_BLOCKING
